Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The frame change affects geometry and posted motion.
I checked the laws in upstream/main at dab6498aed0ab078a97f0892c417d161135219fa.
The local trial merge was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

What looks good:
- The refusal names the angle, limits, and A 0 B 180 remedy.
- The command, MCP, UI, and frame tests cover the reported defect.
- I read all 140 lines of examples/first-4axis-part.nc. Its four flat cuts agree after each index.
- No existing golden files changed. The example NC file is identical to the parent PR's file.

Requested before merge:
1. [Safety] crates/cl/src/cl/frame.rs:80 — Protect operations saved with the old frame basis. At A0/B180, an old local point (0, -19.05) maps to world (-19.05, 0). This change maps it to (0, +19.05). Existing typed geometry therefore rotates when the user regenerates it. The PR changes neither the project loader nor the tilt stamp. operation::params::digest::wt still hashes only the angle and origin values. operation::status_of can thus report the old cached path as current, although generation now gives a different path. Add a versioned basis or a migration that preserves the intended cut. Refuse affected old operations with a visible diagnostic if safe conversion is not possible. Invalidate incompatible caches. Add an old-project test that checks load, status, regeneration, and posting. The decision file acknowledges the rotation but does not prevent it.
2. crates/ui/src/feedback.rs:130 — Add before/after screenshots of the changed Apply hint to the PR body. The body has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only pr-screenshots branch. Link them from the body.

Local results:
- CL library: 44 passed.
- App first_4axis_part: 3 passed; tilt: 8 passed; tilt_a180: 2 passed; tormach_fourth_axis: 12 passed.
- UI library, from crates/ui: 914 passed, 6 ignored. UI feedback: 7 passed.
- Guide test_first_4axis_part.py: 12 passed.
- Compatibility check: loaded the pre-fix example project from 06dfbcaafab3e6bc98fd2cbed85c9ee884bbfd2c. The existing load-and-post test passed. It reported no migration notes and accepted the old cached path under the new frame code. The fixture was restored.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-cl -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

Mutation checks:
- Replaced cl/frame.rs with upstream/main: a0_b180_frame_keeps_plane_x_on_machine_x failed with u=[0.0, 1.0, 0.0]. Restored the file: passed.
- Replaced operation/types/sane.rs with upstream/main: out_of_range_tilt_refuses_by_name_with_a0_b180_remedy failed with the generic refusal. Restored the file: passed.
- All mutation changes were restored. No change was committed or pushed.

Notes:
- Keep the stated merge order: #2135 first. This branch contains the earlier parent model. The parent correction at 7c960e97 must survive the eventual merge-time refresh.
- params.rs and sane.rs already exceed 400 lines and grow further. Move the tilt validation to a suitable module when practical.
- Zola is not installed. Rendered guide navigation was not tested. The GUI and a physical machine were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Saved tilt compatibility: basis 0 preserves old coordinates and compatible caches. Basis 1 uses a distinct cache stamp. Project format 63 protects new saves from older readers. The five tests in `tilt_basis_compat` check load, status, regeneration, posting, cache refusal, JSON defaults, and version guards. Four mutations failed, then passed after restoration.
2. Apply hint screenshots: the PR body links both real shell renders. The images exist only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. `apply_hint_names_tilt_limits_and_a0_b180_remedy` failed with the parent source and passed after restoration.

New head: `5b1b1afa5422f64919ab57ee280f20457e304ae8`.

The exact quick gate ran all ten steps. Nine passed. UI failed on `post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`: `Harness::run` exceeded `max_steps(4)` during a scroll repaint. The UI retry and isolated test failed too. A freshly rebuilt reviewed-head binary reproduces this failure from the same worktree path. A shorter temporary path passes. I did not change unrelated code.

Clippy passed on all targets of `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-app`, and `camcraft-ui`, with warnings denied. The example NC program is unchanged.

Please re-review this head.

Needs changes before merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects geometry and posted motion.
I used the current laws from upstream/main at f90e9dc8ecd32a17d5a0379ff7d52f040a3c9d69.
The local trial merge was clean. No GitHub runner was used.

The earlier findings:
- The versioned basis now preserves the old frame coordinates. The digest distinguishes basis 1 from basis 0. Unknown versions are refused.
- The PR body now links before/after screenshots. I opened both images. The new hint names the limits and the A 0 B 180 remedy.
- The compatibility tests need the corrections below before they prove the full contract on current main.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs:23`: Update the remaining `Tilt` initializer in `crates/app/tests/clearance_in_stock.rs:264`. It has no `basis_version`. The trial merge fails all-target clippy with E0063. Select the intended basis explicitly. Run the affected test and clippy again.
2. `examples/first-4axis-part.camproj:553`: Regenerate the example caches under the current stamp and verification laws. The committed project cannot post after the trial merge. `the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program` fails with `Flat A-90: inputs moved since generation - regenerate before posting`. Main changed the stamp salt to v3 in #2155. Keep that safety invalidation. Check the resulting NC program line by line if regeneration changes it.
3. `crates/app/tests/tilt_basis_compat.rs:47`: Adapt the compatibility tests to the current cache contract. The old fixture correctly reads `Stale` under the v3 salt, but this test requires `Ok`. It stops before regeneration and posting. The assertion at line 107 also fails in `corrected_basis_rejects_a_legacy_cache_stamp`. Keep a genuine old-project test that checks regeneration and the preserved cut. Use a cache generated under the current verification law to isolate basis-only invalidation. Check the refusal through the posting entry point that reports stale inputs. Do not make old verification verdicts current to pass these tests.
4. `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:100`: Mark the project-format change as breaking in the commit metadata. Version 63 makes version-62 readers refuse newly saved projects. The commits use plain `fix` subjects and have no `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. The current laws require a breaking marker for this format change.

Local build and test results, with the trial merge:
- CL library: 44 passed.
- App tilt: 8 passed. App tilt_a180: 2 passed. App tormach_fourth_axis: 12 passed.
- App first_4axis_part: 2 passed, 1 failed.
- App tilt_basis_compat: 3 passed, 2 failed.
- UI library, from crates/ui: 914 passed, 6 ignored. UI feedback: 7 passed.
- Guide test_first_4axis_part.py: 12 passed.
- Clippy: failed with `error[E0063]: missing field basis_version in initializer of camcraft_app::operation::Tilt` at `clearance_in_stock.rs:264`.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: completed. This was a plan only, not a passing gate.

Mutation checks:
- Disabled the frame seed's float-dust correction. `a0_b180_frame_keeps_plane_x_on_machine_x` failed with `u=[0.0, 1.0, 0.0]`. Restored the source: passed.
- Replaced `operation/types/sane.rs` with upstream/main. `out_of_range_tilt_refuses_by_name_with_a0_b180_remedy` failed with the generic refusal. Restored the source: passed.
- Both mutations returned exit 101 before restoration and exit 0 after restoration. All mutation edits were restored.

Goldens and scope:
- No existing `.nc` or `.cl` golden changed. I read all 140 lines of the added example NC program. Its four flat cuts agree after each index. It is identical to the program in parent commit 06dfbcaafab3e6bc98fd2cbed85c9ee884bbfd2c.
- Preserve the stated stack order: #2135 first. Its newer parent correction at 7c960e97 must survive the merge-time refresh.
- I did not run pixel snapshots, release heavy tests, Zola, the interactive GUI, or a physical machine.
- No change was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Missing tilt basis: `clearance_in_stock.rs` now selects basis 1. `the_word_stands_down_where_only_the_law_can_know` passes. All eight clearance tests pass. Removing the field caused E0063. Restoring it passed.
2. Example caches: regenerated all five stamps under the current v3 verification law. `the_committed_project_posts_the_committed_program` passes. Restoring the old caches failed with the stale-input diagnostic. Restoring the regenerated caches passed. All three example tests pass. The NC program is byte-identical.
3. Compatibility tests: the genuine old project remains stale until regeneration. Regeneration preserves every saved path and the intended posted program. `old_project_keeps_basis_status_regeneration_and_posted_cut` pins this contract. `corrected_basis_rejects_a_legacy_cache_stamp` now uses a cache generated under the current verification law. It checks stale-input refusal through both posting entry points. Both tests failed under their mutations and passed after restoration. All five compatibility tests pass. The v3 safety invalidation remains intact.
4. Format metadata: the new commit has a breaking subject and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer for project format 63. The metadata assertion failed on the reviewed commit and passed on the new commit.

Merged current upstream main with a clean merge commit. No manual conflict resolution was needed.

New head: `855e119c27fd377ca9ad277baf13a6fcc55a16b1`.

Validation on this head:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: all 10 steps passed. The command selected the batch tier because shared CL code changed.
- All-target clippy passed for `camcraft-cl`, `camcraft-app`, and `camcraft-ui`, with warnings denied.
- Guide tests: 12 passed.
- All mutation edits were restored. No screenshot, log, or review evidence was committed.

Please re-review this head. The PR remains a draft.
